storedFileSchemaDrift.rootCause: The running EF model references StoredFiles.StorageState and StoredFiles.SupersededByFileId, but the configured real SQL Server database does not contain those columns. __EFMigrationsHistory stops at 20260621200235_HardenCampaignReviewWorkflow while repository migrations include later StoredFile lifecycle migrations. The live table also has ReplacedByFileId instead of the model property SupersededByFileId.
reproduction: Start API with current branch and configured database.
Set doctor price and fund company wallet.
POST /api/company/campaigns/{campaignId}/submit with Idempotency-Key before assets, or upload multipart asset.
Observe 500 envelope; API log shows Microsoft.Data.SqlClient.SqlException: Invalid column name StorageState/SupersededByFileId.
storedFileSchemaDrift.expected: Workflow validation responses for submit-before-asset, successful asset upload/persist metadata, and campaign submission after approved assets.
storedFileSchemaDrift.actual: 500 unexpected error on submit and upload paths; downstream campaign review stays 409 because campaign never reaches PendingReview.
storedFileSchemaDrift.suggestedFix: Apply/reconcile the pending StoredFiles lifecycle migrations against the configured database, including the StorageState and SupersededByFileId model columns, or update the EF mapping/migration history to match the actual ReplacedByFileId schema. Then rerun the blocked file/campaign workflow.

cloudinarySignedUrlGeneration.rootCause: GET /api/files/{fileId} reaches CloudinaryFileStorageProvider.CreateSignedReadUrlAsync and CloudinaryDotNet.AuthToken.Generate throws System.FormatException: Could not find any recognizable digits. Cloudinary AuthToken.HexStringToByteArray is receiving the configured API secret, which is not in the hex format expected by that AuthToken code path.
cloudinarySignedUrlGeneration.request: Authorized company GET for its own uploaded campaign asset.
cloudinarySignedUrlGeneration.expected: 200 envelope with signed Cloudinary URL and expiry.
reproduction: Observe 500 and API log FormatException in CloudinaryDotNet.AuthToken.HexStringToByteArray.
cloudinarySignedUrlGeneration.suggestedFix: Investigate Cloudinary signed/authenticated URL generation for non-hex API secrets. Use the Cloudinary SDK-supported signing/token method for the configured secret format, or validate required secret format at startup and return a controlled 503 from storage provider failures.
